remarks: Renovated, move-in-ready condo located in the heart of New Canaan village. This spacious end unit features large picture windows providing excellent natural light. The interior includes an eat-in kitchen with a built-in sitting banquette and new stainless steel appliances, alongside a large living room with a fireplace and a tandem dining room. The home offers three large ensuite bedrooms and a finished lower level suitable for a playroom or home gym. Additional amenities include a half bath, a laundry room, an attached garage, and a private fenced patio. Residents also enjoy access to the Cobbler's Green community pool. The property is ideally situated in town within walking distance of the village center, library, restaurants, shops, schools, and parks. It also offers convenient access to the express train to New York City.
